newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:
Spokesman Jochen Kubosch briefed on the Court of Justice judgments.

Asked why Commissioner Manuel Marin had been heard in camera by the European Parliament's budget committee, spokesman Josep Coll i Carbo did not deny that it was at the Commissioner's request but added that the final decision lay with the parliament.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/528 REV: The European Commission approves the labelling of genetically modified organisms.
- IP/97/533: European Commission proposes an action programme for pollution-related diseases.
- IP/97/540: The Commission's five strategies for developing apprenticeships within the EU.
- IP/97/541: Commission approves the creation of TARGOR, a joint venture between HOECHST and BASF for polypropylene.
- IP/97/542: Commission clears acquisition of APV by SIEBE.
- Speech/97/139: Speech by Commiussioner Joao de Deus Pinheiro on "the give and take of development - European perspective".
- Speech/97/141: Speech by Commissioner Padraig Flynn on "foundations in partnership: the example of social inclusion in Europe".
- Speech/97/142: Speech by Commissioner Edith Cresson at 15th EUREKA Ministerial Conference.
- Eurostat news release No 42/97 CORRECTED: EU unemployment in April 1997.
